record.field:
🌷 Bloom & Brunch

A morning workshop where guests create their own bouquet while enjoying a light brunch (coffee, pastries). A relaxed, social atmosphere, great for attracting customers who love an "experience" element alongside shopping.

📅 When: Saturday morning, 10:00–12:00

📍 Where: In-store / garden patio

👥 Capacity: 8–12 guests

💶 Price: €35–45 per person (includes brunch + bouquet materials)

🌼 What's included:

  • Welcome coffee & pastries
  • Guided bouquet-making session
  • Take-home bouquet + care card
  • Small discount voucher for future purchases

📝 Good to know: Booking required, non-refundable but transferable. Aprons provided, no experience needed!
Master a floral technique in one afternoon

record.field:
🌿 Petal Workshop

A hands-on creative workshop focused on a specific technique: Japanese floral art (ikebana), dried flower crowns, or seasonal arrangements. Works well as a paid format and makes for great, engaging social media content.


📅 When: Weekday evening, 18:00–20:00

📍 Where: In-store workshop space

👥 Capacity: 6–10 guests

💶 Price: €50–70 per person (materials included)

🌸 What's included:

  • Step-by-step technique demo (ikebana, dried flower crowns, or seasonal arrangement)
  • All tools & flowers provided
  • Take-home creation
  • Glass of wine or tea

📝 Good to know: Choose your theme in advance. Great gift idea — "buy a seat" option available!
Shopping, but make it an evening out

record.field:
🌙 Flowers After Dark

An exclusive evening shopping event with a complimentary drink, soft music, and special discounts. Perfect for customers who work during the day, and creates a distinct "event" feel around the shop.

📅 When: One Thursday per month, 18:30–21:00

📍 Where: In-store, after regular hours

👥 Capacity: Open house (no limit, RSVP appreciated)

💶 Price: Free entry

🍷 What's included:

  • Complimentary drink
  • Soft music / ambient lighting
  • Exclusive discounts (10–15% that evening only)
  • First look at new arrivals

📝 Good to know: Casual, drop-in style — perfect for after-work customers.
